market_question: Will Arsenal finish in 2nd place in the 2025-26 English Premier League?
reasoning: Arsenal have been the second-best team in the Premier League for several seasons, finishing 2nd in 2022–23 and 2023–24, and are likely to do so again in the still-unfolding 2024–25. Projecting into 2025–26, their squad strength and stability under Arteta suggest they have roughly a 22% chance of finishing exactly second, compared to the market's implied 16.5%. The difference is large enough to warrant a position.
evidence_points: Arsenal finished 2nd in both 2022–23 and 2023–24, and are on track for a top-two finish in 2024–25.
The team has a young core and a stable manager, making another strong season in 2025–26 probable.
Manchester City remain favorites, but Arsenal are the most likely to finish directly behind them, mirroring recent patterns.
sources_consulted: General football analysis of squad strength
